body: ac-09 scope: docs/DEVELOPMENT.md gained the full ft_ surface + profile→schema→validate teaching (durable, in-tree). The community description.yml (extended_description/hello_world) was NOT touched — it documents the LIVE v0.6.22 community submission, which does not contain the ft_ verbs (they ship in a later release). Teaching unshipped functions there would be wrong. Deferred to the next community publish; follow-up task filed. ac-10 evidence: transcript-2026-06-03.txt + transcript.sql + people_schema.json in this spec folder, captured on DuckDB v1.5.3 against a freshly make-build-release'd stable-ABI extension.

ft_profile simplified to a table-in form: ft_profile('table') SQL macro now coexists with the ft_profile(LIST) scalar under one name (DuckDB routes by call position), symmetric with ft_validate('table',schema). Added ft_detail as the fourth utility ft_ alias (was missing; finetype_detail had no ft_ name). Both verified live on DuckDB 1.5.3 in transcript-2026-06-03.txt.
